command: PATH=$RUST_BIN:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$SHARED_TARGET CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo build --release --workspace
redaction: Replace the root checkout absolute path with $CANDIDATE_SOURCE; preserve all build diagnostics, crate compilation rows and completion duration.
targetPolicy: Coordinator builds release workspace, including CLI bins, after baseline snapshot. All local crates recompiled from root checkout paths; complete log lists Compiling rows. No tests are built by this command.
buildScopeDifference: Baseline uses --bins; this candidate uses --workspace. The latter also builds native wasm/wasm-jit libraries and enables esp32s3/cache-inline and xtensa-lx7/wasm-cache-inline through wasm default features. All use sites are gated to wasm32; esp32s3/src/bus.rs:set_approximate_cache_inline returns false unconditionally on native. No claim that command/feature graphs are identical.
comparisonStatus: Retained unmeasured initial build snapshot. The final comparison requires a candidate --bins build matching baseline target scope and feature graph.
